prompt: Continue the Relay static/mock implementation with one narrowly bounded consistency fix. RelayDispatcher now includes top-level timeout_seconds in duplicate-intent hashing, but DispatchEnvelope/DuplicateGuard still hashes payload only. Extend DispatchEnvelope so its deterministic packet/intention hash can include an optional top-level timeout_seconds value as part of the canonical intent object, with missing/None deterministic and backward-compatible for existing callers. Preserve payload deep-copy snapshot semantics and correlation/slot behavior. Do not add live provider execution, networking, auth/API/billing/settings changes, persistence, retry, fallback, or unrelated refactors. Add focused tests proving: same slot + same payload + same timeout => SAME_REQUEST; same slot + same payload + different timeout => CONFLICT; payload key order remains deterministic; caller payload mutation after build cannot change payload/hash; existing callers without timeout continue to work. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, and git diff --check.
